description: Labelled prompts for the instruction router of .agents/hooks/personality-reinject.mjs. Each `expect` lists what a careful reader of the AGENTS.md router would load for the prompt: a section id (frontmatter `id`) or an import path. Labels follow the router, not the classifier: a miss or a false hit is fixed in a section's `triggers:`, never by relabelling. Bilingual on purpose (ES/EN).
